title: GTV 300 Sei Giorni
description: Representing Vespa's prowess in the Commuter Scooter class, the Vespa GTV 300 Sei Giorni is delivers ultra-nimble urban agility for riders navigating congested city centers. A 300cc powerplant pumps out 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
